360-full-stack.label: 360 Full Stack
360-full-stack.tagline: End-to-end execution. Strategy, creative, performance — owned entirely in-house.
360-full-stack.problemHeading: Broken systems most brands are stuck in

problemGrid.title: Vanishing Agencies
problemGrid.description: They show up with great energy and big promises. Once onboarded, they suddenly disappear. Calls get shorter, updates get vaguer and somehow nothing is on time.

problemGrid.title: Pretty But Pointless Creatives
problemGrid.description: Your feed looks stunning but your ROAS doesn't. Beautiful creatives without performance thinking is just expensive art and empires aren't built on aesthetics alone. Brand positioning and sales have to work as one.

problemGrid.title: Junior Handoff
problemGrid.description: Founders sold you the vision but execution went to a junior three levels down. No senior eyes on your account, no accountability at the top, just a fresh face learning on your brand's dime.

problemGrid.title: Vendor Chaos
problemGrid.description: Multiple vendors, zero ownership of outcomes and the founder stuck in the middle, coordinating instead of building. When nobody owns the outcome, the outcome owns you.

servicesGrid.name: Performance Marketing
servicesGrid.subtext: Meta, Google, YouTube, marketplaces, we manage every rupee of your ad spend like it's coming out of our own pocket.

servicesGrid.name: Brand Positioning & Identity
servicesGrid.subtext: Positioning, archetype, tone of voice, visual identity, we build the brand before we scale it.

servicesGrid.name: Social Media Management
servicesGrid.subtext: Content Calendar, Social Media Management, Strategizing, everything to grow your brand's digital presence.

servicesGrid.name: Website & Technology
servicesGrid.subtext: Build and optimise storefronts, landing pages and checkout flows that are designed to perform.

servicesGrid.name: UGC
servicesGrid.subtext: Build a UGC pipeline that gives your brand the social proof it needs to convert cold audiences into loyal customers.

servicesGrid.name: SEO
servicesGrid.subtext: We build category defining content, optimise your websites and engineer your search presence so your brand grows organically.

global-expansion.label: Global Expansion
global-expansion.tagline: Take your brand across borders. Localisation, market entry, and international growth.
global-expansion.problemHeading: Broken systems most brands are stuck in

problemGrid.title: No Market Entry Playbook
problemGrid.description: No channel mapping, no category benchmarks, no understanding of what the local consumer actually buys and why. That's not expansion, that's an expensive experiment.

problemGrid.title: Compliance Blind Spot
problemGrid.description: Every market has its own rulebook for ad regulations, labelling laws, data privacy mandates, import duties etc. One missed compliance detail can pull your product off shelves before you've even found your footing.

problemGrid.title: Platform Blindness
problemGrid.description: Meta and Google work everywhere, but TikTok, Pinterest, Amazon's etc play by different rules in each market. Brands that don't adapt their channel mix burn budget on the wrong rooms.

problemGrid.title: Lost in Translation
problemGrid.description: Word-to-word translation isn't localisation. What works in India falls flat in foreign countries. A brand that doesn't speak the market's language never earns its trust.

servicesGrid.name: Multi-Market Paid Media
servicesGrid.subtext: We manage market specific paid media across Meta, Google and local platforms with messaging engineered for each audience.

servicesGrid.name: Brand Adaptation Framework
servicesGrid.subtext: We build a localisation framework that keeps your core identity intact while adapting your positioning, tone and story to resonate with a completely new consumer.

servicesGrid.name: Market Specific Creatives
servicesGrid.subtext: We make sure each creative is market specific, built around local culture, local behaviour and local buying psychology.

servicesGrid.name: Localised Storefronts
servicesGrid.subtext: Building storefront with multi-currency pricing, regional language support, local payment gateways and compliance so it feels native to the market it's selling.

servicesGrid.name: Platform-Native Social Strategy
servicesGrid.subtext: Each country and platform has a different playbook. We build a platform specific social strategy for each targeted market.

servicesGrid.name: Global Retention Architecture
servicesGrid.subtext: CAC is significantly higher in mature markets. We build market specific lifecycle flows designed to turn first time international buyers into long-term revenue.

retention.label: Retention
retention.tagline: Turn one-time buyers into lifetime customers. Loyalty, lifecycle, and repeat revenue.
retention.problemHeading: Broken systems most brands are stuck in

problemGrid.title: Retention Treated as Afterthought
problemGrid.description: Email, SMS and WhatsApp aren't just broadcast tools, they're your highest-ROI retention engine. Most people set up just a welcome flow and wonder why repeat purchases never come.

problemGrid.title: High Acquisition. Zero Retention.
problemGrid.description: Brands spend lakhs bringing customers in through the front door while they quietly leave through the back. A business that can't retain is funding its own churn and no amount of ad spend fixes a broken retention engine.

problemGrid.title: No Post Purchase Experience
problemGrid.description: Most brands go silent once an order is placed. The post-purchase window is your highest intent moment and the most wasted opportunity in D2C.

problemGrid.title: Ignoring Already Existing Data
problemGrid.description: Purchase frequency, cart abandonment etc is all sitting in your backend. Brands that don't build retention flows around this data are leaving their most profitable customers unattended.

servicesGrid.name: Retargeting & Loyalty-Focused Paid Media
servicesGrid.subtext: We build retargeting architectures designed specifically to re-engage and convert existing customers back into repeat buyers.

servicesGrid.name: Retention Specific Creative
servicesGrid.subtext: Creative built for the customer who already purchased, because content that earns a second purchase looks nothing like the content that earned the first.

servicesGrid.name: Loyalty & Subscription Infrastructure
servicesGrid.subtext: We build and implement the full retention tech stack like loyalty tiers, subscription flows, post-purchase automations, referral programs etc.

personal-branding.label: Personal Branding
personal-branding.tagline: Build the founder behind the brand. Thought leadership, presence, and positioning.
personal-branding.problemHeading: Broken systems most brands are stuck in

problemGrid.title: Invisible Founder
problemGrid.description: In a world where consumers buy from people before they buy from brands, a founder who isn't visible is leaving the most powerful trust signal off the table.

problemGrid.title: No Consistent Voice
problemGrid.description: Without a defined tone and a set of consistent content pillars you're not building a personal brand. You're just making noise between the gaps.

problemGrid.title: Chasing Virality, No Authority
problemGrid.description: Going viral feels like winning until nobody remembers your name the next morning. Authority isn't built on reach, it's built on relevance, consistency and a point of view people keep coming back for.

problemGrid.title: Separating Founder From Brand
problemGrid.description: Most founders hide behind their company logo scared that personal visibility will overshadow the brand. The reality is the opposite. A strong founder voice is the most cost effective brand building tool in existence.

servicesGrid.name: Founder Positioning Framework
servicesGrid.subtext: We build your positioning, point of view and visual identity so your personal brand has a foundation for every piece of content.

servicesGrid.name: Personal Website & Newsletter Infrastructure
servicesGrid.subtext: Social platforms change algorithms. Your website and newsletter don't. We build your personal digital home that gives you a direct unfiltered line to the audience you're building.

servicesGrid.name: Platform Content Strategy
servicesGrid.subtext: We build platform native content strategy around your authentic expertise intentionally engineered to build authority where it matters most.

servicesGrid.name: Personal SEO
servicesGrid.subtext: We build your search presence through strategic content, backlink architecture and category defined positioning so you rank before you're even in the room.

banner.headline: Clueless about growing your D2C brand?
banner.subheadline: Your brand doesn't need to grow. It needs to compound.
banner.subtext: Branding and Performance all under one roof so your business can actually compound, because that's how empires are built.

points.title: Exclusivity
points.description: We work with one brand per vertical. Not because we can't handle more, but because your competitor shouldn't share strategies and insights. We are not here to cater the masses but to build a brand that stands out.

points.title: Complete In-House Team
points.description: No freelancers, no outsourced surprises. Every person working on your account is a Clueless team member who knows your brand inside out, because they've been building it from day one.

points.title: Creative + Performance
points.description: Beautiful work that actually performs. We refuse to choose, because the brands that compound are the ones where every creative decision is also a performance decision.

points.title: Top Management Led
points.description: No junior handoffs. You get direct access to top management, always. Because the people who sold you the vision are the same ones delivering it.
